name: Clutch & Release
source:
You already know your next target. You've been following her for weeks, this is your chance. She can't escape you and you won't let her until you've had your fill.

[From [url=https://bruisedhedonist.itch.io/clutch-and-release]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经知道你的下一个目标了。你已经关注她好几个星期了，这是你的机会。她无法逃离你，你也不会让她离开，除非你吃饱了。

[来自[url=https://bruisedhedonist.itch.io/clutch-and-release]itch.io[/url]]
